utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Monday the thirteenth. Can you all hear me, or am I talking to myself again?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: We can hear you. I'm just mourning the broken coffee machine in the canteen. Terrible start to a Monday.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Tell me about it. My weekend plans involved a barbecue and the weather involved horizontal rain.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: That's not a barbecue, that's a British barbecue. Different specification.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: And the football last night didn't improve matters. All that possession and absolutely nothing at the end of it.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Sounds like my internet connection. If I freeze, it's probably that, not deep thought.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before we lose you, let's get going. Quality first?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, so, tested the water system yesterday and it's all fine now. That's finished.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: That was the one left over from the weekend, wasn't it?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: That's it. Closed out, nothing outstanding from that test.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: And I already swapped the filter on the GT2 inlet valve yesterday. That one's done as well.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: The filter, yeah. Not the sensor calibration, though?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Just the filter. I'm not saying the sensors were recalibrated. Definitely no second filter change needed.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Right, I'll recalibrate the sensors on the GT2 inlet valve tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Tom. Sensors on the GT2 inlet valve tomorrow morning, agreed.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, two different things. Easy to lose that distinction when the job descriptions get shortened.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Exactly. Mine's the calibration, not repeating the filter job.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: What about the permit to work and isolation for the GT2 bearing? That still needs sorting.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: I'll sort the permit to work and isolation for the GT2 bearing, ready tomorrow at 9:30. Not an emergency but don't let it slip — that's how I'm treating it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Cheers, Fi. Tomorrow at 9:30, agreed. We don't want that drifting.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yep, that's mine.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Tom, can you take vibration readings on the air compressor?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll take vibration readings on the air compressor.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Proper numbers rather than the old 'sounds a bit different' method.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Oi, that's a highly calibrated ear. But yes, actual vibration readings.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: While we're on air, the supplier still hasn't confirmed the delivery for the Compressed Air Dryer. That's still a blocker.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: So there's no confirmed delivery to put in the schedule. Same position as before.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly. Blocked, not a new delivery job for anyone today.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Separate thing, Olu: can you chase the purchase order for the GT2 by Thursday? Whenever you get a chance.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yep, I'll chase the purchase order for the GT2 by Thursday. I'll fit that in when I get a chance.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Just keeping those separate, then — that's the purchase order, not the unconfirmed delivery.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: That's right. Purchase order chase is mine.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Oh, and I heard a slight rattle from the water system. Nothing to action yet, just an observation.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, the testing yesterday was all fine. That observation doesn't change the completed test result.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, observation only. We're not turning that into another job on this call.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Next bit — the site visit at the warehouse with the contractor. Still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: I'll do a site visit at the warehouse with the contractor by end of day. Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Davey. That's agreed, by end of day.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah. Just the visit we're talking about, nothing more elaborate.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: And the toolbox talk for the team — we haven't covered who's organising that.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: I'll organise the toolbox talk for the team today as well. Normal priority on that one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, David Whitfield against organising the toolbox talk for the team today, normal priority.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Full name. Blimey, feels like I'm back outside the headteacher's office.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Only if you've forgotten your PE kit again.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Behave. Guarding on the wrapper next. That check needs an owner.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: I'll check the guarding on the wrapper today at 2pm. That one's safety critical, straight away — not one to leave sitting behind routine stuff.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Agreed, Davey. Today at 2pm is the check time; safety critical, straight away is the priority. We're not pushing it back for routine work.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Absolutely. Today at 2pm, I've got it.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, safety critical. Clear distinction from the normal-priority bits.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Aisha, can you do the pre-use checks on the FLTs? Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Sorry, no, I can't take those on. I haven't got the capacity for that as well.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: All right. Fiona, can I hand the pre-use checks on the FLTs to you instead? Still normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yes, I'll do the pre-use checks on the FLTs instead.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Thanks, sorry about that. Better to say now than pretend I can squeeze it in.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: No, fair enough. They're with me, normal priority.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: One more from me. I'll swap the filter on the line one HPU after lunch. It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Dave. Filter on the line one HPU after lunch, agreed. Important, not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Sorry, talking over you — that's the HPU filter, not the inlet one we mentioned earlier.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yep, line one HPU. Different filter, different job.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: And the GT2 inlet valve filter is already done, just to put that firmly to bed.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good. Anything else from quality, or is that everything?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: That's everything from me. No extra work to add.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Same here. And my coffee machine complaint was purely emotional support, not a maintenance request.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Good, because I can't recalibrate the weather for next weekend either.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, we've got the agreed jobs and the delivery blocker stays a blocker. Thanks, everyone. Let's leave it there.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Cheers, all.
